item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 2 #SLPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 2 #SLPRSD
Issued at 12:30 PM 24 September 2026

Moderate to heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #Romblon(SanFernando, SantaFe, Looc, Alcantara), #CamarinesSur(Tinambac, Goa, Lagonoy, Presentacion, SanJose, Calabanga, Pili, Ocampo, NagaCity, DelGallego, Ragay, Garchitorena, Caramoan, Siruma), #Sorsogon(Pilar, Donsol), #Catanduanes(SanAndres, Caramoran), #Albay(Camalig, Guinobatan, Jovellar, PioDuran), #CamarinesNorte(SantaElena, Labo, SanVicente, SanLorenzoRuiz), #Marinduque(Gasan, Buenavista, Boac, Torrijos), #NorthernSamar(SanIsidro, LasNavas, Catubig, SilvinoLobos, Mondragon, LopeDeVega), #OrientalMindoro(SanTeodoro, PuertoGalera, Baco, Naujan and CityOfCalapan) within the next 1 to 2 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #Sorsogon(Bulan), #OrientalMindoro(Mansalay, Bulalacao), #Masbate(Mandaon, Milagros, Cawayan, Placer and Balud) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
